sequence.cn: 网上常说：他这次翻车了。
sequence.py: Wǎngshàng cháng shuō: tā zhè cì fān chē le.
sequence.en: Online you hear it all the time: he really crashed this time.

sequence.cn: 翻车，就是当着大家的面，说的和做的对不上了。
sequence.py: Fān chē, jiù shì dāngzhe dàjiā de miàn, shuō de hé zuò de duì bu shàng le.
sequence.en: 翻车 is when, in front of everyone, what you said and what you did stop matching up.

sequence.cn: 越是把话说满，越容易翻车。
sequence.py: Yuè shì bǎ huà shuō mǎn, yuè róngyì fān chē.
sequence.en: The bigger the promise you make, the easier it is to crash.

sequence.cn: 我关注的一个主播，那天在直播间卖护肤品。
sequence.py: Wǒ guānzhù de yí ge zhǔbō, nà tiān zài zhíbōjiān mài hùfūpǐn.
sequence.en: A streamer I follow was selling skincare in her livestream that day.

sequence.cn: 她说这瓶不到一百块，敏感肌用也绝对没问题。
sequence.py: Tā shuō zhè píng bú dào yìbǎi kuài, mǐngǎnjī yòng yě juéduì méi wèntí.
sequence.en: She said it's under a hundred kuai and absolutely safe even for sensitive skin.

sequence.cn: 夸得天花乱坠，三分钟就卖了十万瓶。
sequence.py: Kuā de tiānhuā luànzhuì, sān fēnzhōng jiù mài le shí wàn píng.
sequence.en: She hyped it to the skies — a hundred thousand bottles sold in three minutes.

sequence.cn: 没过几天，评论区全是一句话：用完过敏了。
sequence.py: Méi guò jǐ tiān, pínglùnqū quán shì yí jù huà: yòng wán guòmǐn le.
sequence.en: A few days later the comments were all the same line: I broke out after using it.

sequence.cn: 退货的人越来越多，避雷的帖子也越来越多。
sequence.py: Tuìhuò de rén yuè lái yuè duō, bìléi de tiězi yě yuè lái yuè duō.
sequence.en: More and more people returned it, and more and more "steer clear" posts went up.

sequence.cn: 她后来删了那场回放，也再没说过绝对两个字。
sequence.py: Tā hòulái shān le nà chǎng huífàng, yě zài méi shuō guo juéduì liǎng ge zì.
sequence.en: She later deleted the replay — and never said the word "absolutely" again.
